records.label: spacr.selection#18
records.source: *An untyped key is LESS SPECIFIC, not wrong.* ``plate1_r1_c1_f1_7`` means "the object labelled 7 in that field", which is exactly what it always meant — so it matches that object whatever its type, rather than silently matching one of them. Symmetrically a typed key still matches a row that has not said what it is. :meth:`Selection.mask_for` and :meth:`ObjectRequest.select_from` both apply that rule, and it is the whole migration: an old key is read as the thing it always said, never re-read as something narrower.
records.context: *An untyped structured-data name is LESS SPECIFIC, not wrong.* ``plate1_r1_c1_f1_7`` means "the object labelled 7 in that microscope field of view", which is exactly what it always meant — so it matches that object whatever its type, rather than silently matching one of them. Symmetrically a typed structured-data name still matches a row that has not said what it is. :meth:`Selection.mask_for` and :meth:`ObjectRequest.select_from` both apply that rule, and it is the whole migration: an old structured-data name is read as the thing it always said, never re-read as something narrower.
records.translation: *Ótegundað nafn á uppbyggðu gögnum er MINNI NÁKVÆMT, ekki rangt.* ``plate1_r1_c1_f1_7`` þýðir „hluturinn merktur 7 í því smásjársviði“, sem er nákvæmlega það sem það hefur alltaf þýtt — svo það passar við þann hlut sama hvaða tegund hann er, frekar en að passa hljóðlaust við einn þeirra. Samhverft passar nafn á tegundaruppbyggðu gögnum samt sem áður við röð sem hefur ekki sagt hvað hún er. :meth:`Selection.mask_for` og :meth:`ObjectRequest.select_from` beita báðu þeirri reglu, og þetta er allur flutningurinn: gamla nafnið á uppbyggðu gögnum er lesið sem hið sem það hefur alltaf sagt, aldrei endurlesið sem eitthvað þrengra.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#91
records.source: **Blur is nearly free.** Going from 0 % to 300 % costs 0.01-0.11 ms, which on three of the five themes is inside the run-to-run spread. It is one area-averaging pass over a buffer of half a megapixel at most, and the blit that carries the result to the screen was going to happen anyway. The honest alternative — a separable box blur over the buffer in NumPy, two cumulative sums per axis — was written and measured at **12.8 ms** on a 640x360 buffer, nine times this module's whole budget, which is why it is not what ships. ``drift`` is the exception it always was: it has no buffer, so its blur is a second wider pass per dot and it has a cap (:data:`DRIFT_HALO_MAX_PX`).

It is one area-averaging pass over a buffer of half a megapixel at most, and the blit that carries the result to the screen was going to happen anyway. The honest alternative — a separable box blur over the buffer in NumPy, two cumulative sums per axis — was written and measured at **12.8 ms** on a 640x360 buffer, nine times this module's whole budget, which is why it is not what ships. ``drift`` is the exception it always was: it has no buffer, so its blur is a second wider pass per dot and it has a cap (:data:`DRIFT_HALO_MAX_PX`).
records.translation: **Blúrsía er næstum ókeypis.** Að fara frá 0 % í 300 % kostar 0,01–0,11 ms, sem á þremur af fimm þemum er innan dreifingar vinnslufundarinnar til keyrslu. Þetta er eitt meðaltalsferli yfir svæði á skyndiminni af hálfri megapíxel að hámarki, og flutningurinn sem ber útkoman á skjáinn myndi gerast engu að síður. Heilæðislega valkosturinn — aðskiljanleg boxblúrsía yfir skyndiminnið í NumPy, tvö samfelld summum á hverri ás — var skrifaður og mældur við **12,8 ms** á 640x360 skyndiminni, níu sinnum heildarfræðsla þessa einingar, sem er ástæðan fyrir því að það er ekki það sem er sent. ``drift`` er undantekningin sem það hefur alltaf verið: það hefur ekkert skyndiminni, svo blúrsían er annar breiðari ferill á hvern punkt og hún hefur þak (:data:`DRIFT_HALO_MAX_PX`).

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart#1
records.source: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks. The positive and negative controls are supposed to be *the same thing every time*: that is what makes hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' mean anything at all. When the controls stop being the same — the cell line drifts, a reagent lot changes, the incubator door is left open on a Friday — everything computed downstream is already wrong, and nothing in the analysis says so, because the analysis normalises to the controls it is given.
records.context: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks. The positive and negative controls are supposed to be *the same thing every time*: that is what makes hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' mean anything at all. When the controls stop being the same — the cell line drifts, a reagent lot changes, the incubator door is left open on a Friday — everything computed downstream is already wrong, and nothing in the analysis says so, because the analysis normalises to the controls it is given.
records.translation: Skríningaherferð er tugi platta keyrðir yfir vikur. Jákvæðu og neikvæðu stjórnin á að vera *sama hluturinn í hvert skipti*: það er það sem gerir að kalla út árangur, platta normaliseringu og Z' merkingu eitthvað virði yfirleitt. Þegar stjórnarnir hætta að vera eins — frumulínan breytist, lota af efniviði breytist, dyr inní hitakassa eru skilin opnar á föstudegi — þá er allt sem reiknað er áfram rangt, og ekkert í greiningunni segir það, vegna þess að greiningin normaliserar miðað við stjórnirnar sem henni eru gefnar.

The primaries are a channel-to-colour mapping and only channels belong in it. Aðalbreytingar eru kortlagning myndagagna rásar yfir í lit og aðeins myndagagnarássar tilheyra henni. Útlínur eru ekki myndagagnaráss -- það er litur sem notandi valdi, eða flokkunarmerki -- svo að það að setja það í gegnum sama fylki myndi vera að svara beiðni um rauða útlínu með gulu. Endurlitaðu myndina og teiknaðu svo ofan á.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.hover_tooltip#20
records.source: Only one tooltip ever appears. The screens that anchor this popup also leave a native Qt tooltip on the same label (``refresh_api_tooltips`` re-applies it on every ``Enter``, for the accessibility tree), and Qt's own tooltip timer would pop that up a second later, on top of this one — two tooltips, one after the other. Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for screen readers.
records.context: Only one tooltip ever appears. The application views that anchor this popup also leave a native Qt tooltip on the same label (``refresh_api_tooltips`` re-applies it on every ``Enter``, for the accessibility tree), and Qt's own tooltip timer would pop that up a second later, on top of this one — two tooltips, one after the other. Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for application view readers.
records.translation: Aðeins einn upplýsingabogi birtist nokkru sinni. Forritsskoðanir sem festa þetta sprettiglugga skilja einnig eftir innfæddan Qt upplýsingaboga á sama merkimiða (``refresh_api_tooltips`` setur hann aftur á hverjum ``Enter``, fyrir aðgengistréið), og eigin tímastillir Qt upplýsingabogsins myndi koma honum upp sekúndu síðar, ofan á þennan — tveir upplýsingabogar, annar á eftir hinum. Að krefjast festingar setur því :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` á hann, sem gleypir ``QEvent.ToolTip`` meðan ``toolTip()`` helst óskert fyrir lesendur forritsskoðana.

records.label: spacr.crop_source.matches_path#1
records.source: Two independent tests, which is the whole point of splitting them: WHICH OBJECT the crop is of (a substring of its path, e.g. ``cell_png``) and WHAT FORMAT it is in (its extension). One setting could never express "every nucleus crop, whatever format" or "every TIFF, whatever object".
records.context: Two independent tests, which is the whole point of splitting them: WHICH OBJECT the extracted image region is of (a substring of its path, e.g. ``cell_png``) and WHAT FORMAT it is in (its extension). One setting could never express "every nucleus extracted image region, whatever format" or "every TIFF, whatever object".
records.translation: Tvö sjálfstæð próf, sem er allan tilganginn með því að skipta þeim: HVERS HLUTS myndsvæðið sem var tekið út er (undirstrengur af slóð þess, t.d. ``cell_png``) og Í HVÍLKU SNIÐI það er (viðbót þess). Einn stilling gæti aldrei lýst „hverju kjarnatjáningu myndsvæðis, óháð sniði“ eða „hverju TIFF, óháð hlut“.

records.label: spacr.seg_qc#4
records.source: Design constraint: this runs right after segmentation on every field of the plate, so it must be cheap. Everything below is ``np.bincount`` on a label image — microseconds per field. The one expensive check (the distance-transform cross-check for fusion) runs *only* on fields dense enough for fusion to be the explanation, so a healthy plate never pays for it. Like :mod:`spacr.diameter`, this module imports **no torch and no cellpose** — that is a tested property (see ``tests/test_seg_qc.py``), not an aspiration.
records.context: Design constraint: this executes right after segmentation on every microscope field of view of the laboratory microplate, so it must be cheap. Everything below is ``np.bincount`` on a label image — microseconds per microscope field of view. The one expensive check (the distance-transform cross-check for fusion) runs *only* on microscope fields of view dense enough for fusion to be the explanation, so a healthy laboratory microplate never pays for it. Like :mod:`spacr.diameter`, this module imports **no torch and no cellpose** — that is a tested property (see ``tests/test_seg_qc.py``), not an aspiration.
records.translation: Hönnunarþröskuldur: Þetta framkvæmist rétt eftir hlutaskiptingu á hverju smásjárahorni rannsóknarstofunnar ördiskífu., svo það verður að vera ódýrt. Allt fyrir neðan er ``np.bincount`` á merkimiða mynd — míkrósekúndur á hverju smásjársvið. Eina dýra athugunin (fjarlægð-breytingar krossathugunin fyrir samruna) keyrir *aðeins* á smásjársviðum nægilega þéttum fyrir samruna til að vera skýringin, svo heilbrigð tilraunaplata borgar aldrei fyrir það. Eins og :mod:`spacr.diameter` flytur þessi modul inn **enginn torch og enginn cellpose** — þetta er prófuð eign (sjá ``tests/test_seg_qc.py``), ekki löngun.

records.label: spacr.qt.settings_search#5
records.source: **an Essentials / All switch** — the progressive disclosure. Essentials shows the module's inputs plus the handful of decisions :func:`spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.essential_keys` derives from its curated layout, expanded and ready; All restores every heading, collapsed as before. Essentials is the default on a module's first visit and the choice is remembered per module thereafter, so a returning expert never meets the training wheels twice.

records.translation: **Grunnatriði / Allt rof** — stigvaxandi birting. Essentials sýnir inntök mótsins ásamt fáum ákvörðunum sem :func:`spacr.qt.screens.settings_model.essential_keys` dregur af mótaða uppsetningu sinni, stækkað og tilbúið; All endurheimtir alla fyrirsagnir, samanbrotna eins og áður. Essentials er sjálfgefið við fyrstu heimsókn á módúl og valið er munað fyrir hvern módúl eftir það, svo að sérfræðingur sem kemur aftur mætir aldrei æfingahjólunum tvisvar.
